map.按公路-Ⅰ/Ⅱ级车道荷载，组合桥梁恒载、车道活载与人群荷载，计算简支梁跨中弯矩与: Using highway class I/II lane loads, combine bridge dead load, lane live load and pedestrian load to compute mid-span moment and support shear of a simply supported beam and check the ultimate limit state combination.
map.桥梁设计荷载组合：将恒载（结构自重、桥面铺装）与活载（车辆、人群）按规范系数组合: Bridge design load combination: combine dead load (self weight, deck surfacing) with live load (vehicles, pedestrians) by code factors to get the worst-case load intensity at the control section, for reinforcement and foundation design.
map.施工阶段临时荷载评估：挂篮、支架、堆载等临时荷载叠加恒载，验算支架与地基承载力，: Temporary load assessment during construction: hanging baskets, falsework and stockpiles add to dead load, so check falsework and foundation bearing capacity to prevent instability or settlement during construction.
map.改造加固前荷载核查：老旧桥梁在用荷载标准已提高时，用本工具复核原结构是否仍满足现: Load check before retrofit or strengthening: when the load standard for an existing old bridge has been raised, use this tool to check whether the structure still meets current combinations and decide the scope of strengthening.
map.：恒载 80 kN/m、活载 60 kN/m、恒载分项系数 1.2、活载 1.4: : dead load 80 kN/m, live load 60 kN/m, dead load partial factor 1.2, live load 1.4: basic combination load intensity = 1.2 × 80 + 1.4 × 60 = 180 kN/m. Raising live load to 100 shows how the combination value affects section internal forces.
map.恒载与活载的荷载系数怎么取？: How are dead and live load factors chosen?
map.公路桥梁按 JTG D60 承载能力极限状态采用恒载 1.2、活载 1.4（城-: Highway bridges use JTG D60 ultimate limit state with dead load 1.2 and live load 1.4 (city-A / highway class I), with different frequent/quasi-permanent combination factors; buildings use GB 50009, and details follow the code tables.
map.多车道布载时按规范进行车道折减（横向分布系数与车道数折减），本工具给出单梁线荷载: For multi-lane loading apply code lane reduction factors (transverse distribution factor and lane count reduction); this tool gives single-beam line load intensity, and an overall model must multiply the distribution factor in spatial analysis.
map.结果能直接用于配筋吗？: Can the result be used directly for reinforcement?
map.荷载集度只是输入，配筋还需结合内力、材料强度与裂缝验算；本工具结果应作为结构整体: Load intensity is only an input; reinforcement also needs internal forces, material strength and crack checks, so this tool's result should serve as a check and preliminary step for overall structural calculation.
